threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You catch yourself apologizing to pigeons for bumping into them on the pavement. Locals just walk straight through.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham, and a couple were loudly arguing over a missing pizza slice. The driver just shook his head, like he's seen it all before.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I heard a spontaneous techno party in the courtyard after midnight, the bass thumping through my window, I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find street art that becomes part of the building's identity. Those murals tell stories that few other cities would dare to embrace.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot tourists by their puzzled faces at the BART delays. Locals just roll their eyes and check their phones for the next bus—if they even bother.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy feeding a pigeon a slice of sourdough on the L streetcar today. Only in SF would the bread be organic and the bird look a bit overweight.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think all bars close early, but the best ones don’t even get busy until after midnight. Locals know where the real parties are.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their confusion at the plethora of 'bici' stickers on bike racks—still thinking it’s a local slang, not a sign of bike-sharing.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'East London' means Shoreditch, while everyone else knows it’s really Hackney and beyond.
Caught the N59 last night, and the bus driver had a full-on karaoke session with a couple of regulars—never seen such vibes at 2 AM!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a hidden little café behind a thrift store, where the barista remembers my name and the street art outside shifts with the seasons.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find spontaneous parties in U-Bahn stations here—last weekend, I stumbled upon a silent disco at Warschauer Strasse. Only in Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You hear someone call it 'BART' not 'the BART'—that's a sure sign they grew up navigating those rusty trains like a pro.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that made an unexpected stop just to let a street performer finish his song. They cheered as he wrapped up. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just hop on any tram, but most don't even notice that the T3 line stops right at the edge of Plaça del Sol.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they order a café con leche — always saying 'lactosa' instead of 'llet'. A telltale sign they’re fresh off the plane.
